name: structural-format-structure-table
body: Each claimed format must emit exactly the structure named for it: `md` headings, `sh` functions, `yaml` keys/jobs/steps, `json` keys, `toml` tables/keys, `xml` elements, `dockerfile` stages and FROM/RUN/COPY/ENV instructions, `makefile` targets/variables/includes, `ini` sections/keys; `misc` emits a File node only. A format that emits only a File node, or structure beyond the named depth, violates the contract.
